system.description: A durable one-handed baton chassis with powered, force and stun configurations.
system.specialRules: Melee Weapon; charged settings can add DP when powered.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): deal damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Parry (+): gain Protection d6 against melee; Accuracy 1.
  • Stun (+): with Stun Setting, target resolves two Speed Dice.
system.upgrades:
• Demolition (Q): harder to use, but can damage Structure.
  • Energy Baton (Q): Powered; Capacity +8; charged hit 1d6+SB every third turn.
  • Enhanced Battery (Q): Capacity +5 and faster recharge cycle.
  • Linked (Q): external power; charged hits can be used continuously.
  • Force Setting (Q): charged hit becomes 1d8+SB.
  • Stun Setting (Q): enables Stun configuration.
  • Switchblade (Q): adds piercing/slashing mode.
  • Telescoping (Q): Concealment 1.
  • Tonfa Configuration (Q): Martial Arts option and stronger Parry.

system.description: A one-handed blade chassis supporting monomolecular, vibro and toxin-delivery variants.
system.specialRules: Defensive; Melee Weapon.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Armor Piercing (+): attack ignores Armor this round.
  • Hit (+): deal damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Parry (+): gain Protection d6 against melee when the model supports it.
system.upgrades:
• Concealed (Q): hidden/retractable blade gains Concealment.
  • Monomolecular (Q): gain/increase Deadly 1.
  • Switchblade (Q): Concealment while closed.
  • Tebbit (QQ): toxin microtubes; poison/drug delivery.
  • Two-Handed: larger profile, d6+SB damage, Parry, loses Defensive.
  • Vibroblade (Q): Powered; damage becomes d6+SB.

system.description: Powered impact plates worn over the hands; can be paired and configured for force or stun.
system.specialRules: Charged Hit every 3 turns: 1d6+SB and +1 DP; Concealment 1; Defensive; Open Hand; Paired gives +1 Bonus Die; Stun-capable.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1; may be charged.
  • Stun (+): target resolves two Speed Dice.
system.upgrades:
• Linked (Q): external power; every hit can be charged.
  • Force Setting (Q): loses Stun; charged damage becomes 1d8+SB.
  • Stun Setting (Q): Stun-only; charged hit available every other turn.

system.description: A two-handed martial staff that can be built from advanced composite or force technology.
system.specialRules: Ace can resolve Speed Dice from up to two melee targets; Martial Arts; Out of Place.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Parry (+): Protection d6 and may resolve attacker success; Accuracy 1.
  • Stun (+): target resolves two Speed Dice.
  • Full Defense: negate one attacker’s melee damage for the round; cannot Hit.
system.upgrades:
• Composite (Q): improved Parry protection.
  • Force (Q): Powered, Capacity 8, increases damage; second end may be upgraded.
  • Telescoping (QQ): removes Out of Place.

system.description: A two-handed sword chassis favored by martial specialists and Meth collectors.
system.specialRules: Ace grants an additional melee damage opportunity; Martial Arts; Out of Place; Deadly 1.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Armor Piercing (+ or Speed): attack ignores Armor.
  • Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Stab (++): target loses d6+SB HP directly; Accuracy 1.
  • Parry (+): Protection d6 against melee; Accuracy 1.
system.upgrades:
• Composite (Q): improves Parry protection.
  • Concealed (Q): reduced size and Concealment 1.
  • Katana (Q): Martial Arts (-3), damage d8+SB.
  • Monomolecular (Q): Deadly +1.
  • Vibroblade (Q): Powered and +1 Bonus Die to attacks.

system.description: A powered demolition hammer whose charged field can breach armor and structures.
system.specialRules: Charged Hit every 3 turns: d8+SB, Armor Piercing, +1 DP; Out of Place; Powered 2; Stun-capable.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Armor Piercing (+ or Speed): attack ignores Armor.
  • Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1; may be charged.
  • Power Strike (Speed): add/increase Deadly 1 for the round.
system.upgrades:
• Demo-Model (Q): charged hits can damage Structure; Heavy +1.
  • Linked (Q): external power; every hit can be charged.

system.description: Power Knuckles configured with their official Force Setting.
system.specialRules: Power Knuckles + Force Setting: charged hit 1d8+SB; loses Stun; Concealment 1; Defensive; charged use adds DP.
system.triggeredEffects: • Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1; charged hit uses force profile.
system.upgrades: • Linked (Q): external power; every hit can be charged.

system.description: Bay City Police .357 revolver with configurable ammunition and carbine options.
system.specialRules: Revolver; Carbine-ready; Requisition: Bay City Police.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Deploy (Speed): requires Stock.
  • Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Focus Fire (Speed or DP): Firearms +2 and Damage +2.
  • Reload: remove 1 DP per two Speed Dice; can load one special round.
system.upgrades:
• Auto Loader (Q): faster full reload.
  • Carbine (Q): deployable stock, Bonus Die while deployed, two-handed.
  • Composite Barrel (Q): enables EMP and Reaper rounds.
  • Sight, Laser (Q): Firearms +1 in Shared Zone; Powered.
  • Thermal Shielded Barrel (Q): enables Armor Penetrating and Plasma rounds.

system.description: CTAC service pistol designed to link with Praetorian armor.
system.specialRules: Linked to Praetorian Armor; +1 Bonus Die only while linked; Magazine; Rare; Standard Issue: CTAC.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload (Speed): clear DP with a fresh magazine.
  • Saturation Fire (Speed or DP): Firearms +2 and Damage +2.
  • Suppressive Fire (Speed or DP): pressures targets using Cover.

system.description: A highly concealable compact pistol usable even at grapple range.
system.specialRules: Concealment 2; Defensive; Short Ranged.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload (Speed): clear DP with a fresh magazine.
system.upgrades:
• Thermal Shielded Barrel (Q): Armor Penetrating/Plasma rounds.
  • Composite Barrel (Q): EMP/Reaper rounds.
  • Sight, Laser (Q): Firearms +1 in Shared Zone; Powered.

system.description: Reliable configurable police sidearm.
system.specialRules: Magazine; Requisition: Bay City Police.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload (Speed): fresh magazine clears DP.
  • Saturation Fire (Speed or DP): Firearms +2 and Damage +2.
  • Suppressive Fire (Speed or DP): pressures targets using Cover.
system.upgrades:
• Extended Magazine (Q): Capacity 15.
  • Sight, Laser (Q): Firearms +1 in Shared Zone; Powered.
  • Thermal Shielded Barrel (Q): Armor Penetrating/Plasma rounds.

system.description: Early hybrid-style General Systems pistol firing conventional and special ammunition.
system.specialRules: Magazine (entry notes a 9-round magazine despite Capacity 6); built-in laser sight and thermal-shielded barrel.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Suppressive Fire (Speed or DP): pressures targets in Cover.
  • Saturation Fire (Speed or DP): Firearms +2 and Damage +2.

system.description: Generic configurable solid-projectile firearm chassis covering many real-world style handguns and rifles.
system.specialRules: Choose Pistol or Rifle; choose Magazine or Revolver; set Capacity from chosen model. Damage by caliber: Small d4+PB; Intermediate d6+PB; Large d6+PB; Massive d8+PB.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload (Speed): fresh magazine clears DP.
system.upgrades: • Uses Generic Weapon Upgrades from Core p.206–207.

system.description: Compact high-rate-of-fire carbine/submachine-gun chassis.
system.specialRules: Caliber variants; Carbine; Magazine; Out of Place.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Saturation Fire (Speed or DP): Firearms +2 and Damage +2.
  • Suppressive Fire (Speed or DP): pressures Cover.
system.upgrades:
• Burst Fire (Q): gains 3-Round Burst.
  • Extended Magazine (Q): Capacity +5.
  • Drum Fed (Q): Capacity +10, Heavy +1, no concealment.
  • Linked Weapon (Q): Linked, Powered.
  • Sight, Reflex (Q): Aim/Deploy benefits.
  • Suppressor (Q): makes position harder to detect after firing.

system.description: Hybrid AK/railgun platform restricted to CTAC special operations.
system.specialRules: Magazine; Magnetic Rail adds +1 Damage while powered; Rare; Standard Issue: CTAC; Out of Place.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload (Speed): fresh magazine clears DP.
  • Saturation Fire (Speed or DP): Firearms +2 and Damage +2.
  • Suppressive Fire (Speed or DP): pressures Cover.

system.description: Heavy rifle launching self-propelled explosive frag shells.
system.specialRules: Out of Place; Magazine; Fire Control means no Depletion Check—exhausts when DP reaches Capacity.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 2.
  • Reload (Speed): fresh magazine clears DP.
system.upgrades:
• Drum Fed (Q): Capacity 10, Heavy +1, slower reload.
  • Thermal Shielded Barrel (Q): enables AP and Plasma shells.
  • Sight, Laser (Q): Firearms +1 in Shared Zone; Powered.
  • Linked (Q): Linked; Powered.
  • Folding Stock (Q): grants Deploy.

system.description: Twin-tube tactical shotgun designed to switch between specialized shell types.
system.specialRules: Double Tube Feed tracks two shell types separately; Adjacent attacks Firearms -2; supports specialized shells.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Breach (+): with Breaching Shells, reduce Structure of a stationary object.
  • Hit (+): damage from loaded shell; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload: remove 1 DP per two Speed Dice.
  • Stun (+): with Stunbolt Slugs.
  • Suppressive Fire (Speed or DP): pressures Cover.
  • Switch Ammo Feed (Speed): swap between tube loads.
system.upgrades:
• Open Sight (Q): +1 Bonus Die in Shared Zone.
  • Thermal Shielded Barrel (Q): enables Frag, Tungsten and Plasma shells.

system.description: Configurable high-energy beam rifle with narrow, pulse and wide-beam settings.
system.specialRules: Directed Energy Weapon; Powered energy cell; Rare; Size 2; Slag 1.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 2.
  • Sever (++++ + DP): roll damage three times; may inflict an Injury/sever limb.
system.upgrades:
• Advanced Power Cell (Q): Capacity +5.
  • Heat Dispersal Coils (Q): reroll maximum Depletion result.
  • Narrow Beam (Q): d10 Thermal, longer range, Slag 2.
  • Pulse (Q): d6, loses Sever, counter-only DP.
  • Wide Beam (Q): d6, Shared Zone 90° arc, loses Sever/Slag.

system.description: Military CTAC railgun capable of semi-auto, burst and fully automatic fire.
system.specialRules: Rail Weapon; Magazine; Powered; Rare; Standard Issue: CTAC; supports Semi-Automatic, 3-Round Burst and Fully Automatic.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload (Speed): fresh magazine clears DP.
  • Saturation Fire (Speed or DP): Firearms +2 and Damage +2.
  • Suppressive Fire (Speed or DP): pressures Cover.

system.description: Extremely lethal compact particle accelerator found among elite security and Meth arsenals.
system.specialRules: Directed Energy Weapon; Powered energy cell; Rare; Slag 2; Variable Power Consumption 1.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 2.
  • Reload (Speed): fresh energy cell clears DP.

system.description: General Systems military-grade energy rifle with a devastating configurable arc mode.
system.specialRules: Armor Piercing; Directed Energy Weapon; Powered energy cell; Rare; Slag 1; Variable Power Consumption 1; Arc mode has range-banded thermal damage.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Adjust (two Speed): toggle Arc mode.
  • Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload (Speed): fresh energy cell clears DP.

system.description: CTAC prototype magnetic flechette pistol whose projectiles can be recalled at close range.
system.specialRules: Armor Piercing; Deadly 1; Energy Weapon; Fire Control (counter-only depletion); Pistol; Rare; recalled flechettes only from Shared Zone.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Recall (+): as Move, remove 1 DP; with additional successes recalled flechette may inflict d6 Wounds.

system.description: High-accuracy Mannlicher-Schoenauer licensed pistol with optional directed-energy conversion.
system.specialRules: Magazine; can be converted to directed-energy plasma profile.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
  • Reload (Speed): fresh magazine/power cell clears DP.
system.upgrades: • D.E. Conversion (QQ, Rare kit): switches to Directed Energy Weapon — Plasma (-2), d12+PB Thermal, Powered, Rare, Slag 2, focused/pulse settings.

system.description: Silent assassination weapon firing toxin-laced filament shards with selectable poison payloads.
system.specialRules: Extremely Short Ranged; Spread Shot creates Blast arc; Focused Shot +2 Damage and harder saves.
system.triggeredEffects: • Hit (+): resolve configured payload; Accuracy 1.
system.upgrades:
• Agonizer (Q): d6+PB Poison plus Discipline consequences.
  • Soma (Q): no damage; Endurance test or unconscious.
  • Spider Venom (Q): d10+PB Poison; Accuracy 1.
  • Target Proximity Monitor (Q): change firing mode without Speed cost.

system.description: Flat shaped charges intended for breaching and anti-materiel work.
system.specialRules: Armor Piercing; Breach Charge; Demolition Charge; Shaped Charge uses Engineering rather than Throw.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Demolitions (+): increase Structure damage.
  • Detonation (Speed): resolve demolition damage.
  • Miscalculation (-): reduce Structure damage.
system.upgrades:
• Clutch (Q): carry up to three compactly.
  • Proximity (Q): vehicle-focused trigger.
  • Remote (Q): remote/Linked detonation.

system.description: Nonlethal flash/stun grenade with optional irritant gas, smoke, remote and proximity variants.
system.specialRules: Grenade; nonlethal.
system.triggeredEffects: • Stun (Speed): targets resolve Speed Dice based on successes.
system.upgrades:
• Clutch (Q).
  • Proximity (Q).
  • Remote (Q).
  • Gas, Irritant (Q): lingering Discipline/Endurance burden.
  • Smoke (Q): Perception -2; additional Q adds sensor-scrambling chaff.

system.description: Standard anti-personnel fragmentation grenade with scalable blast damage.
system.specialRules: Grenade.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Cook Grenade (two Speed): Save Throw -2.
  • Direct Hit (++): +3d6 Wounds, all Deadly.
  • Hit (+): +2d6 Damage.
  • Glancing Hit (Speed): +d6 Damage; Deadly 1.
  • Effect Radius (Speed or +): nearby targets save or take d6.
system.upgrades:
• Clutch (Q).
  • Proximity (Q): shaped charge trigger.
  • Remote (Q).
  • Smart Shrapnel (QQ): Armor Piercing and Deadly 2.

system.description: Gas grenade causing hallucination, disorientation and forced Speed-Dice resolution.
system.specialRules: Grenade; Environmentally Sealed targets are immune.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Backdraft (--): friendly target in Shared Zone may be affected.
  • Effect Radius (+): target resolves up to two active Speed Dice.
  • Full Dose (+++): target resolves all Speed Dice and suffers Wounds from results.
system.upgrades:
• Clutch (Q).
  • Proximity (Q).
  • Remote (Q).

system.description: Rapid-deployment microgrenade dispenser with anti-personnel and anti-materiel settings.
system.specialRules: Anti-Materiel and Anti-Personnel settings; Shaped Charge option; each Use adds 1 DP with no Depletion Check.
system.triggeredEffects:
• Anti-Materiel: Demolitions / Detonation / Miscalculation.
  • Anti-Personnel: Cook / Direct Hit / Hit / Glancing Hit / Effect Radius.
system.upgrades:
• Linked (Q): remote detonation and free setting changes.
  • Increased Capacity (Q): +3 Capacity.
  • Proximity (Q): configurable sensor trigger.
  • Stun (Q): adds stun setting.

system.description: Balanced throwing blades suitable for concealed poison delivery.
system.specialRules: Concealment 1; Cumbersome in melee (Melee Combat — Blades (-5), additional -3).
system.triggeredEffects: • Hit (+): damage; Accuracy 1.
system.upgrades:
• Cartridge Dispenser (Q): Capacity 10, altered damage SB-2, cannot be used in melee.
  • Tebbit Knife (Q): toxin/drug delivery.
